# API endpoints

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api_reference.py from the OpenAPI schema. Do not edit. -->

Every endpoint of the ELIES API, grouped by tag. Request and response
schemas are in the interactive reference served by the API at `/docs`
(Swagger UI) and `/redoc`; [API_REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/researchintegrity/elies/blob/main/API_REFERENCE.md)
explains authentication, conventions and the main workflows.

- **Auth**: `bearer` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; `admin` also needs
  the admin role; `-` is public.
- **Deprecated** endpoints still work but will be removed; use the
  replacement named in their description.


## Admin

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/admin/audit-log` | admin | Administrator actions, newest first (quota, role, password, status and account deletion changes). |
| GET | `/admin/stats` | admin | Get system statistics for admin dashboard |
| GET | `/admin/users` | admin | List all users with pagination and optional filters |
| DELETE | `/admin/users/{user_id}` | admin | Delete a user account and all of its data. |
| GET | `/admin/users/{user_id}` | admin | Get detailed information about a specific user |
| PATCH | `/admin/users/{user_id}/quota` | admin | Update a user's storage quota |
| POST | `/admin/users/{user_id}/reset-password` | admin | Reset a user's password |
| PATCH | `/admin/users/{user_id}/role` | admin | Update a user's roles (promote/demote) |
| PATCH | `/admin/users/{user_id}/status` | admin | Activate or deactivate a user account |

## Analyses

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/analyses` | bearer | List analyses with pagination and filtering. |
| GET | `/analyses/by-image/{image_id}` | bearer | Get all analyses associated with a specific image. |
| POST | `/analyses/copy-move/cross` | bearer | Start cross-image copy-move detection analysis. |
| POST | `/analyses/copy-move/single` | bearer | Start single-image copy-move detection analysis. |
| POST | `/analyses/screening-tool` | bearer | Save a screening tool/client-side analysis result. |
| GET | `/analyses/stats` | bearer | Get analysis statistics for the current user. |
| POST | `/analyses/trufor` | bearer | Start TruFor forgery detection analysis. |
| DELETE | `/analyses/{analysis_id}` | bearer | Delete an analysis by ID. |
| GET | `/analyses/{analysis_id}` | bearer | Get analysis details by ID. |
| GET | `/analyses/{analysis_id}/results/{result_type}/download` | bearer | Download an analysis result image file. |

## CBIR - Image Similarity Search

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/cbir/health` | - | Check CBIR service health status. |
| DELETE | `/cbir/index` | bearer | Remove images from the CBIR index. |
| POST | `/cbir/index` | bearer | Index images in the CBIR system for similarity search. |
| DELETE | `/cbir/index/all` | bearer | Remove all user's images from the CBIR index. |
| POST | `/cbir/search` | bearer | Search for images similar to a query image. |
| POST | `/cbir/search/sync` | bearer | Search for images similar to a query image (synchronous). |
| POST | `/cbir/search/upload` | bearer | Search for similar images by uploading an image directly. |

## documents

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/documents` | bearer | List all documents uploaded by current user with pagination. |
| GET | `/documents/tasks/{task_id}` | bearer | Get status of one of the current user's image extraction tasks |
| POST | `/documents/upload` | bearer | Upload a PDF document |
| DELETE | `/documents/{doc_id}` | bearer | Delete a document and its associated extracted images and annotations. |
| GET | `/documents/{doc_id}` | bearer | Get a specific document by ID |
| GET | `/documents/{doc_id}/download` | bearer | Download a document (PDF file) |
| GET | `/documents/{doc_id}/images` | bearer | Get all extracted images from a specific document |
| POST | `/documents/{doc_id}/remove-watermark` | bearer | Initiate watermark removal for a PDF document |
| GET | `/documents/{doc_id}/watermark-removal/status` | bearer | Get watermark removal status for a document |

## dual-annotations

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/annotations/dual` | bearer | Get dual-image annotations for a specific source image. |
| POST | `/annotations/dual` | bearer | Create a new dual-image annotation. |
| POST | `/annotations/dual/batch` | bearer | Create multiple dual-image annotations at once. |
| DELETE | `/annotations/dual/by-link/{link_id}` | bearer | Delete all dual-image annotations with a specific link_id. |

| GET | `/annotations/dual/linked-images/{image_id}` | bearer | Get IDs of images linked to the specified image via dual annotations. |
| DELETE | `/annotations/dual/{annotation_id}` | bearer | Delete a dual-image annotation. |
| GET | `/annotations/dual/{annotation_id}` | bearer | Get a specific dual-image annotation. |
| PUT | `/annotations/dual/{annotation_id}` | bearer | Update an existing dual-image annotation. |

## General

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | - | Root endpoint - API information |
| GET | `/health` | - | Readiness: MongoDB and Redis (task queue, job events) are reachable. |
| GET | `/health/live` | - | Liveness: the process is up and serving requests (no dependency checks). |
| GET | `/health/ready` | - | Readiness: MongoDB and Redis (task queue, job events) are reachable. |

## images

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/images` | bearer | List all images uploaded by current user with pagination and filtering. |
| POST | `/images/extract-panels` | bearer | Initiate panel extraction from selected images |

| GET | `/images/{image_id}/panels` | bearer | Get all panels extracted from a specific source image |
| GET | `/images/{image_id}/thumbnail` | bearer | Get a thumbnail version of an image |
| POST | `/images/{image_id}/types` | bearer | Add types to an image's image_type list |
| DELETE | `/images/{image_id}/types/{type_name}` | bearer | Remove a type from an image's image_type list |
